name: Stability-Adaptive Feature Cache (SAPCR)
tagline: Closed-loop dLLM-Cache: an EMA of step-to-step argmax agreement raises or lowers the gen-refresh interval and modulates transfer ratio per workload.
diff_from_baseline: Extends dllm_cache by replacing fixed gen_refresh_interval with a closed-loop adaptation driven by an EMA of token-argmax agreement, plus a stability-interpolated transfer ratio and per-block resetting; retains lowest-similarity row selector and scatter_refresh kv_update.

name: Convergence-Aware Cache + Early Commit
tagline: Adapts dLLM-Cache intervals from average and minimum feature-similarity over masked positions, and commits ultra-confident tokens early via a 0.99 threshold.
diff_from_baseline: Builds on dllm_cache: per-step adapts gen_refresh_interval from both mean AND min feature-similarity over the local masked window, and adds a 0.99 confidence threshold to the token-transfer plan for early commitment of high-confidence positions.

name: Gate-Aware Uncertainty-Adaptive Cache
tagline: Per-workload presets plus a 0.7*difficulty + 0.3*(1-similarity) uncertainty score that picks one of three (interval, transfer) tiers; lm_eval forced to no-cache.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces dllm_cache's static (interval, transfer) preset with a workload+progress+uncertainty rule that switches among three tiers per workload, gives lm_eval a fast-cache-only-no-skip path, and bumps the token-transfer count by 1 during the early-progress regime.

name: Workload-Routed + Progressive Cache
tagline: Routes lm_eval to the vanilla uncached policy; for math/humaneval, escalates gen_interval and transfer ratio in three progress bins, modulated by an EMA confidence-stability signal.
init_recovers: vanilla_uncached on lm_eval; dllm_cache-style on math/humaneval at progress<0.3
diff_from_baseline: Augments dllm_cache with three progress-binned escalations of (gen_interval, transfer_ratio), an EMA-of-max-prob stability signal that further extends interval, hard caps on G per workload, and an explicit fall-back to vanilla_uncached for lm_eval.

name: PID-Style Difficulty-Driven Cache
tagline: Treats mean token-difficulty as a controlled variable: a proportional law modulates gen_interval, similarity scales transfer_ratio, and importance lengthens prompt_interval.
diff_from_baseline: Same hook surface as dllm_cache (lowest-similarity rows, scatter_refresh) but interval/transfer/prompt are controller outputs: gen_interval driven by a proportional law on mean difficulty error vs 0.5, transfer scaled by 1/similarity, prompt_interval scaled by importance.
